description: Find DataCite repository accounts by name or description text, field of science, repository type, certification (e.g. CoreTrustSeal), software platform, client type, or parent provider, or look up known repository IDs. Returns each repository's repositoryId — the value datacite_search_works takes in repository_ids — with its providerId, name, type, certificates, software, subjects, homepage, and re3data link. To rank repositories by how many works they hold on a topic, run datacite_search_works with that topic and include_facets: true; its repositories facet lists the top ten with counts.

certificates.description: Certificates (any match): CoreTrustSeal, WDS, DSA, DINI, RatSWD, CLARIN, DIN 31644; any case.

client_type.description: Account type: repository, periodical, igsnCatalog, or raidRegistry. Omitted: all.

field_of_science.description: An OECD Fields of Science id or label the repository lists among its subjects, e.g. earth_and_related_environmental_sciences. List: datacite_list_reference topic fields_of_science.

limit.description: Requested repositories per page, 1–10,000; values above 100 apply 100 with a notice.

page.description: Page number. Past the last page the list is empty.

provider_id.description: Parent provider id, e.g. dryad — the providerId a repository carries. Any case.

query.description: Text matched against repository names, alternate names, and descriptions. Query-string syntax is accepted.

repository_ids.description: Known repository ids, shaped provider.repository (e.g. dryad.dryad); any case. Up to 1,000 inputs; queries the first 25 distinct normalized ids and names omitted ids. Use alone — an id lookup ignores query and filters.

repository_types.description: Repository types (any match): institutional, disciplinary, multidisciplinary, project-related, governmental, other.

software.description: Software platform slug, lowercased: dataverse, dspace, invenio, ckan, open_journal_systems_ojs, … (free-form upstream; see datacite_list_reference topic software_platforms).

name: datacite_search_repositories

appliedFilters.description: Every applied filter as sent upstream; {} when none.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_query`: DataCite rejects the syntax of the query input (unbalanced parentheses or quotes, dangling operator). `conflicting_lookup`: repository_ids combined with query or any filter. `rate_limited`: This deployment's shared DataCite request budget is spent: its request queue could not start a request before the call's deadline, or DataCite answered HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextPage.description: Next page number, when more repositories match.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched, the page is past the end, or a requested repository id matched no account.

orderApplied.description: Result order — always by name, as the registry returns it.

repositories.description: Repositories on this page, ordered by name.

repositoryId.description: Repository id — pass to datacite_search_works repository_ids.

repositoryTypes.description: Repository types, e.g. disciplinary (repository_types filter values).

software.description: Software platform, as the registry displays it.

title: Search DataCite repositories
